content:
name: 3.0.$(rev:r)

parameters:
  - name: pipelineDevMode
    displayName: "Pipeline Dev Mode, publish nuget to staging on dev branche"
    type: boolean
    default: false

variables:
  - group: CodeSigningVariables
  - group: RetailJfrogVariables
  - name: system.debug
    value: false
  - name: isMasterOrRelease
    value: ${{ or( startsWith(variables['Build.SourceBranch'],'refs/heads/master'), startsWith(variables['Build.SourceBranch'],'refs/heads/releases/')) }}
  - name: isMasterOrReleaseOrDevMode
    value: ${{ or(variables['isMasterOrRelease'], parameters['pipelineDevMode']) }}
  - name: buildDate
    value: $[ format('{0:yyyy}{0:MM}{0:dd}', pipeline.startTime) ]
  - name: buildImageAspnet8JmeterTag
    value: sqlexpress2019-y2-aspnet-8-windowsservercore-ltsc
  - name: baseImageAspnet8JmeterTag
    value: 2019-y2-aspnet-8-windowsservercore-ltsc2022
  - name: buildImageAspnet6JmeterTag
    value: sqlexpress2019-y2-aspnet-6-windowsservercore-ltsc
  - name: baseImageAspnet6JmeterTag
    value: 2019-y2-aspnet-6-windowsservercore-ltsc2022
  - name: buildImageAspnet10JmeterTag
    value: sqlexpress2019-y2-aspnet-10-windowsservercore-ltsc
  - name: baseImageAspnet10JmeterTag
    value: 2019-y2-aspnet-10-windowsservercore-ltsc2022
  - name: buildImageAspnet10Jmeter2025Tag
    value: sqlexpress2025-y2-aspnet-10-windowsservercore-ltsc
  - name: baseImageAspnet10Jmeter2025Tag
    value: 2025-y2-aspnet-10-windowsservercore-ltsc2025
  - name: windowsAgentVersion
    value: '2022'
  - name: windowsAgentVersion2025
    value: '2025'

trigger:
  branches:
    include:
    - master
    - releases/*

resources:
  repositories:
  - repository: azoTemplates
    type: git
    name: Pipelines_Templates
  - repository: dockerTemplates
    type: git
    name: Pipelines_Docker_BaseImages

stages:
- stage: Build
  jobs:
  - template: Snyk/snyk-scan-job.v1.yml@azoTemplates
    parameters:
      condition: "ne(variables['Build.Reason'], 'PullRequest')"

  - job: Build
    displayName: "Build"
    pool:
      name: Azure Pipelines
      vmImage : 'windows-latest'
    variables:
      - name: toolsName
        value: 'jmeter'
      - name: jmeterPackageConfig
        value: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)\Tools\Jmeter\packages.config'
      - name: jmeterLibPackageConfig
        value: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)\Tools\Jmeter\jmeter-lib.config'
      - name: tmpFolder
        value: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)\tmp'
      - name: scriptsPath
        value: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)\Scripts'
      - name: jmeterDestPath
        value: '$(tmpFolder)\Tools\Jmeter'

    steps:

    # Always sign to run scripts for tests even when they are build on a branch
    - task: CodeSigning@2
      displayName: 'Sign powershell scripts'
      inputs:
        baseDirectory: '$(scriptsPath)'
        searchPattern: |
          **\*.ps1

    # Prepare jmeter
    - task: PowerShell@2
      displayName: 'Check required Files'
      inputs:
        targetType: 'inline'
        script: |

          # Create tmp folder
          New-Item -Path "$(tmpFolder)" -ItemType Directory
          New-Item -Path "$(tmpFolder)\Tools" -ItemType Directory

          # Check exists package.config
          Write-Host "Check for $(jmeterPackageConfig)" -ForegroundColor White
          if (-not(Test-Path -Path "$(jmeterPackageConfig)" -PathType Leaf)) {
              throw "The file '$(jmeterPackageConfig)' does not exist."
          }

          # Check exists jmeter-lib.config
          Write-Host "Check for $(jmeterLibPackageConfig)" -ForegroundColor White
          if (-not(Test-Path -Path "$(jmeterLibPackageConfig)" -PathType Leaf)) {
              throw "The file '$(jmeterLibPackageConfig)' does not exist."
          }

    - task: PowerShell@2
      displayName: 'Download Jmeter'
      inputs:
        targetType: 'inline'
        script: |

          try {

            $packages = [xml](Get-Content "$(jmeterPackageConfig)")

            # Get jmeter node from file
            $ndx = $packages.SelectSingleNode("//packages/package[@id = '$(toolsName)']")

            # Ensure Jmeter node url and version are in packages.config
            if (!$ndx) {
                throw "The file [$sharedToolsPackage] does not contains $(toolsName) node."
            }
            if (!$ndx.version) {
                throw "The file [$sharedToolsPackage] does not contains version in $(toolsName) node."
            }
            if (!$ndx.url) {
                throw "The file [$sharedToolsPackage] does not contains url in $(toolsName) node."
            }

            # Jmeter to install
            Write-Host "Install $($ndx.id) $($ndx.version)" -ForegroundColor White
            $fileNameExt = ([uri]($ndx.url)).Segments[-1]
            $fileName    = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($fileNameExt)
            $tmpDir      = "$(tmpFolder)"

            # Download Jmeter into tempFolder
            Write-Host "Download $($ndx.id) from $($ndx.url) to temp folder $tmpDir" -ForegroundColor White
            $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue' # remove download progress -> Speed-up
            Invoke-WebRequest $ndx.url -OutFile "$tmpDir\$fileNameExt"
            $ProgressPreference = 'Continue'

            # Unzip file into temp folder
            Write-Host "Extract downloaded Archive" -ForegroundColor Green
            Expand-Archive -LiteralPath "$tmpDir\$fileNameExt" -DestinationPath "$tmpDir" -Force
            Write-Host "Jmeter downloaded Successfull" -ForegroundColor Green

            # CopyFolder to sharedTools
            Write-Host "Copy $tmpDir\$fileName to $(jmeterDestPath)" -ForegroundColor White
            Move-Item -Path "$tmpDir\$fileName\" -Destination "$(jmeterDestPath)\" -PassThru

            Write-Host "Jmeter prepared Successfull" -ForegroundColor Green
          } catch {

            Write-Host "An error occurred:" -ForegroundColor Red
            Write-Host $_ -ForegroundColor White
            Write-Host $_.ScriptStackTrace -ForegroundColor White
          }
    #TODO: REMOVE WHEN WE UPDATE JMETER IF JMETER DOESNT HAVE THIS CVE
    - task: PowerShell@2
      displayName: 'Remove vulnerable Jmeter libs (CVE remediation)'
      inputs:
        targetType: 'inline'
        script: |

          # tika-core/tika-parsers 1.28.5 bundled in apache-jmeter-5.6.3 are flagged by
          # JFrog Xray as Critical (CVE-2025-66516, CVE-2025-54988). Upstream fix
          # (apache/jmeter#6701) is open but unmerged and Java-8-capped; we patch ahead
          # of it here with tika-core 3.3.1 (added via jmeter-lib.config) and drop
          # tika-parsers entirely (JMeter never used its parser modules).
          $vulnerableJars = @(
            "$(jmeterDestPath)\lib\tika-core-1.28.5.jar",
            "$(jmeterDestPath)\lib\tika-parsers-1.28.5.jar"
          )

          foreach ($jar in $vulnerableJars) {
            if (Test-Path -Path $jar -PathType Leaf) {
              Write-Host "Removing vulnerable jar $jar" -ForegroundColor Yellow
              Remove-Item -Path $jar -Force
            } else {
              Write-Host "[warning] Expected vulnerable jar not found: $jar (JMeter version may have changed - re-verify tika jar names/versions in the bundled zip)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
            }
          }

    - task: PowerShell@2
      displayName: 'Download Jmeter Libs'
      inputs:
        targetType: 'inline'
        script: |

          # Read package version & url
          Select-Xml -xpath "//package" -path "$(jmeterLibPackageConfig)" | Foreach-Object {
            $node   = $_.Node
            $id     = $node.id
            $url    = $node.url
            $filter = '' + $node.filter
            $target = "$(tmpFolder)\Tools\$($node.target)"

            if ('' -eq $filter) {
              Write-Host("Download lib from $url to $target\$id")
              $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue' # remove download progress -> Speed-up
              Invoke-WebRequest $url -OutFile "$target\$id"
              $ProgressPreference = 'Continue'
            }
            else {
              Write-Host "Download lib archive from $url to $env:TEMP\$id" -ForegroundColor White
              $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue' # remove download progress -> Speed-up
              Invoke-WebRequest $url -OutFile "$env:TEMP\$id"
              $ProgressPreference = 'Continue'

              $fldName = "$env:TEMP\" + [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension("$env:TEMP\$id")

              Write-Host "Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $env:TEMP\$id -DestinationPath $fldName -Force" -ForegroundColor White
              Expand-Archive -LiteralPath "$env:TEMP\$id" -DestinationPath "$fldName" -Force

              Write-Host "Copy files $fldName\$filter to $target\ " -ForegroundColor White
              Copy-Item "$fldName\$filter" -Destination "$target\"
              Write-Host "lib installed Successfull" -ForegroundColor Green
            }
          }

    - task: PowerShell@2
      displayName: 'Copy Jmeter Extra Files'
      inputs:
        targetType: 'inline'
        script: |

          # Copy Jmeter bin & lib  extra file
          $jmeterSrc  = "$(Build.SourcesDirectory)\Tools\Jmeter"
          $jmeterDest = "$(jmeterDestPath)"
          $flds       = Get-ChildItem "$jmeterSrc" -Directory

          Write-Host "Copy Jmeter extra files."

          foreach($fld in $flds){
            Write-Host "Copy $($fld.FullName)\* to $jmeterDest\$($fld.Name)\" -ForegroundColor White
            Copy-Item -Path "$($fld.FullName)\*" -Destination "$jmeterDest\$($fld.Name)\" -PassThru
          }

          Write-Host "Jmeter extra files copied Successfull" -ForegroundColor Green

    - template: Nuget\restore-into-unversioned-folder.v1.yml@azoTemplates
      parameters:
        packageConfig: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)\Tools\Nugets\packages.config'
        fullQualifiedPackagesDirectory: '$(tmpFolder)\Tools'

    # Create nuget
    - task: NuGetCommand@2
      displayName: 'NuGet pack'
      inputs:
        command: pack
        packagesToPack: '.\Y2.Tools.Jmeter.Workflow.nuspec'
        packDestination: '$(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)\Nuget'
        basePath: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)'
        versioningScheme: byEnvVar
        versionEnvVar: Build.BuildNumber
        arguments: '-tools'

    - task: PublishPipelineArtifact@1
      displayName: 'Publish package on pipeline'
      inputs:
        targetPath: '$(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)'
        artifact: '$(Build.Repository.Name).$(Build.BuildNumber)'
        publishLocation: 'pipeline'

    - task: JFrogNuGet@1
      displayName: 'Artifactory NuGet push'
      # SAFE TEST BRANCH: build the nupkg but never publish it to Artifactory.
      condition: eq(1, 0)
      inputs:
        command: push
        artifactoryConnection: ArtifactoryCloudV2-Retail
        targetDeployRepo: 'retail-nuget-staging/$(Build.Repository.Name)/'
        pathToNupkg: '$(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/*.nupkg'
        collectBuildInfo: true
        failNoOp: true

    - task: JFrogPublishBuildInfo@1
      displayName: 'Publish Artifactory BuildInfo'
      # SAFE TEST BRANCH: do not create/update an Artifactory build record.
      condition: eq(1, 0)
      inputs:
        artifactoryConnection: ArtifactoryCloudV2-Retail
        buildName: '$(Build.DefinitionName)'
        buildNumber: '$(Build.BuildNumber)'

- stage: JMeter_ServerCore_ltsc_dotnet8
  # SAFE TEST BRANCH: Docker build template pushes the image to staging.
  condition: eq(1, 0)
  displayName: Build (JMeter-windowsservercore-ltsc) dotnet8
  dependsOn:
    - Build
  variables:
    - template: .\Docker\Y2-JMeter\vars-build.yml # Set variables with base image tag
      parameters:
        buildImageTag: ${{ variables.buildImageAspnet8JmeterTag }}
        baseImageTag: ${{ variables.baseImageAspnet8JmeterTag }}
        windowsAgentVersion: ${{ variables.windowsAgentVersion }}
    # Windowsversion for the used windowsserver core tag can be found here : https://hub.docker.com/_/microsoft-windows-servercore
    - name: expectedWindowsVersion
      value: "10.0.20348.1906"
  jobs:
    - template: .\Docker\Y2-JMeter\job-build.yml

- stage: JMeter_ServerCore_ltsc_dotnet6
  # SAFE TEST BRANCH: Docker build template pushes the image to staging.
  condition: eq(1, 0)
  displayName: Build (JMeter-windowsservercore-ltsc) dotnet6
  dependsOn:
    - Build
  variables:
    - template: .\Docker\Y2-JMeter\vars-build.yml # Set variables with base image tag
      parameters:
        buildImageTag: ${{ variables.buildImageAspnet6JmeterTag }}
        baseImageTag: ${{ variables.baseImageAspnet6JmeterTag }}
        windowsAgentVersion: ${{ variables.windowsAgentVersion }}
    # Windowsversion for the used windowsserver core tag can be found here : https://hub.docker.com/_/microsoft-windows-servercore
    - name: expectedWindowsVersion
      value: "10.0.20348.1906"
  jobs:
    - template: .\Docker\Y2-JMeter\job-build.yml

- stage: JMeter_ServerCore_ltsc_dotnet10
  # SAFE TEST BRANCH: Docker build template pushes the image to staging.
  condition: eq(1, 0)
  displayName: Build (JMeter-windowsservercore-ltsc) dotnet10
  dependsOn:
    - Build
  variables:
    - template: .\Docker\Y2-JMeter\vars-build.yml # Set variables with base image tag
      parameters:
        buildImageTag: ${{ variables.buildImageAspnet10JmeterTag }}
        baseImageTag: ${{ variables.baseImageAspnet10JmeterTag }}
        windowsAgentVersion: ${{ variables.windowsAgentVersion }}
    # Windowsversion for the used windowsserver core tag can be found here : https://hub.docker.com/_/microsoft-windows-servercore
    - name: expectedWindowsVersion
      value: "10.0.20348.1906"
  jobs:
    - template: .\Docker\Y2-JMeter\job-build.yml

- stage: JMeter_ServerCore_ltsc2025_dotnet10
  # SAFE TEST BRANCH: Docker build template pushes the image to staging.
  condition: eq(1, 0)
  displayName: Build (JMeter-windowsservercore-ltsc2025) dotnet10
  dependsOn:
    - Build
  variables:
    - template: .\Docker\Y2-JMeter\vars-build.yml # Set variables with base image tag
      parameters:
        buildImageTag: ${{ variables.buildImageAspnet10Jmeter2025Tag }}
        baseImageTag: ${{ variables.baseImageAspnet10Jmeter2025Tag }}
        windowsAgentVersion: ${{ variables.windowsAgentVersion2025 }}
    # Windowsversion for the used windowsserver core tag can be found here : https://hub.docker.com/_/microsoft-windows-servercore
    # TODO: confirm the exact Windows Server 2025 (ltsc2025) build number once the base image is available
    - name: expectedWindowsVersion
      value: "10.0.26100.1742"
  jobs:
    - template: .\Docker\Y2-JMeter\job-build.yml

- stage: Promote
  # SAFE TEST BRANCH: no NuGet/Docker promotion and no source tag.
  condition: eq(1, 0)
  dependsOn:
    - JMeter_ServerCore_ltsc_dotnet8
    - JMeter_ServerCore_ltsc_dotnet6
    - JMeter_ServerCore_ltsc_dotnet10
    - JMeter_ServerCore_ltsc2025_dotnet10
  variables:
    - group : RetailJfrogVariables
  jobs:
  - job: InStaging_Validation
    displayName: 'Artifact InStaging Validation'
    pool: server
    timeoutInMinutes: 14400 # job times out in 10 days
    steps:
    - task: ManualValidation@0
      timeoutInMinutes: 14400 # task times out in 10 days
      inputs:
        notifyUsers: |
          [Retail]\Platform DevX
        instructions: 'Please validate artifacts in staging state to promote them in production'
        onTimeout: 'reject'

  - job: JFrog_Promote_Nuget
    dependsOn: InStaging_Validation
    displayName: 'Promote Nuget'
    condition: and(succeeded(), eq(variables.isMasterOrReleaseOrDevMode, true) )
    pool:
      vmImage : 'windows-latest'
    steps:
    - task : JFrogBuildPromotion@1
      displayName: 'Promote Nuget'
      inputs:
        artifactoryConnection: ArtifactoryCloudV2-Retail
        targetRepo: 'retail-nuget-production'
        sourceRepo: 'retail-nuget-staging'
        buildName: '$(Build.DefinitionName)'
        buildNumber: '$(Build.BuildNumber)'
        includeDependencies: true

  - job: JFrog_Promote_Docker_Aspnet8_Image
    dependsOn: InStaging_Validation
    displayName: 'Promote Aspnet8 DockerImage'
    condition: and(succeeded(), eq(variables.isMasterOrReleaseOrDevMode, true) )
    pool:
      vmImage : 'windows-latest'
    variables:
      - template: .\Docker\Y2-JMeter\vars-build.yml # Set variables with base image tag
        parameters:
          buildImageTag: $(buildImageAspnet8JmeterTag)
          baseImageTag: $(baseImageAspnet8JmeterTag)
          windowsAgentVersion: $(windowsAgentVersion)
    steps:
    - template: Pipeline_Templates/task-publish-docker-image.yml@dockerTemplates
      parameters:
        imageLabel: $(imageLabel)
        imageProductionTag: $(imageProductionTag)
        imageProductionLatestTag: $(imageProductionLatestTag)

  - job: JFrog_Promote_Docker_Aspnet6_Image
    dependsOn: InStaging_Validation
    displayName: 'Promote Aspnet6 Docker Image'
    condition: and(succeeded(), eq(variables.isMasterOrReleaseOrDevMode, true) )
    pool:
      vmImage : 'windows-latest'
    variables:
      - template: .\Docker\Y2-JMeter\vars-build.yml # Set variables with base image tag
        parameters:
          buildImageTag: $(buildImageAspnet6JmeterTag)
          baseImageTag: $(baseImageAspnet6JmeterTag)
          windowsAgentVersion: $(windowsAgentVersion)
    steps:
    - template: Pipeline_Templates/task-publish-docker-image.yml@dockerTemplates
      parameters:
        imageLabel: $(imageLabel)
        imageProductionTag: $(imageProductionTag)
        imageProductionLatestTag: $(imageProductionLatestTag)

  - job: JFrog_Promote_Docker_Aspnet10_Image
    dependsOn: InStaging_Validation
    displayName: 'Promote Aspnet10 Docker Image'
    condition: and(succeeded(), eq(variables.isMasterOrReleaseOrDevMode, true) )
    pool:
      vmImage : 'windows-latest'
    variables:
      - template: .\Docker\Y2-JMeter\vars-build.yml # Set variables with base image tag
        parameters:
          buildImageTag: $(buildImageAspnet10JmeterTag)
          baseImageTag: $(baseImageAspnet10JmeterTag)
          windowsAgentVersion: $(windowsAgentVersion)
    steps:
    - template: Pipeline_Templates/task-publish-docker-image.yml@dockerTemplates
      parameters:
        imageLabel: $(imageLabel)
        imageProductionTag: $(imageProductionTag)
        imageProductionLatestTag: $(imageProductionLatestTag)

  - job: JFrog_Promote_Docker_Aspnet10_2025_Image
    dependsOn: InStaging_Validation
    displayName: 'Promote Aspnet10 ltsc2025 Docker Image'
    condition: and(succeeded(), eq(variables.isMasterOrReleaseOrDevMode, true) )
    pool:
      vmImage : 'windows-latest'
    variables:
      - template: .\Docker\Y2-JMeter\vars-build.yml # Set variables with base image tag
        parameters:
          buildImageTag: $(buildImageAspnet10Jmeter2025Tag)
          baseImageTag: $(baseImageAspnet10Jmeter2025Tag)
          windowsAgentVersion: $(windowsAgentVersion2025)
    steps:
    - template: Pipeline_Templates/task-publish-docker-image.yml@dockerTemplates
      parameters:
        imageLabel: $(imageLabel)
        imageProductionTag: $(imageProductionTag)
        imageProductionLatestTag: $(imageProductionLatestTag)

  - job: Tag_Sources
    dependsOn:
     - JFrog_Promote_Nuget
     - JFrog_Promote_Docker_Aspnet8_Image
     - JFrog_Promote_Docker_Aspnet6_Image
     - JFrog_Promote_Docker_Aspnet10_Image
     - JFrog_Promote_Docker_Aspnet10_2025_Image
    steps:
    - checkout: self
      clean: true
      # enable persistCredentials to keep AccessToken to the GIT repository until job end
      persistCredentials: true

    - template: Git\tag-sources.v1.yml@azoTemplates
      parameters:
        gitTag: V$(Build.BuildNumber)
